We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the reaction: protecting group removal? Actually description: TBS protecting group introduced, then removed. The retrosynthetic step: we need to break O-Si bond, forming free alcohol (aliphatic hydroxyl) and removing TBS group. So we need a template that breaks O-Si bond, forming hydroxyl and TBS fragment (maybe silyl chloride). The forward reaction: alcohol + TBDMSCl -> protected alcohol (O-Si). In retrosynthesis, we go from protected alcohol to alcohol + TBDMSCl (or TBDMSOTf). So we need a template that breaks O-Si bond, forming alcohol and silyl halide.

We have target molecule: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

Let's examine: It contains an O attached to a carbon (maybe a protected alcohol). The O is attached to a carbon that is part of a cyclic structure? The SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

There is an O attached to chiral carbon 1, then that carbon is part of a ring with other substituents. There's also O[C@@H]... maybe the O is part of a silyl ether? But I don't see Si in SMILES. Actually the SMILES does not contain Si. So maybe the molecule is already deprotected? Wait the description says "as a result of this reaction, a bond between oxygen and silicon is broken, and a 'aliphatic hydroxyls' functional group is formed, and a 't-butyldimethylsilyl' gone." So the target molecule is the product after deprotection (free alcohol). So we need to find a template that when applied to this molecule (target) gives precursors: the protected version (with O-Si) and maybe TBDMSCl. So we need a template that adds a TBS group to an alcohol.

Thus we need to search template catalog for a template that breaks aliphatic hydroxyl (functional group formed) and forms t-butyldimethylsilyl (functional group broken). In forward reaction, O-Si formed, hydroxyl broken. In retrosynthesis, we want to break O-Si (i.e., remove silyl) and form hydroxyl. So we need template where functional_groups_broken includes "t-butyldimethylsilyl" and functional_groups_formed includes "aliphatic hydroxyls". Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

Let's call tool with molecule_smiles = given SMILES, functional_groups_broken = ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"], functional_groups_formed = ["aliphatic hydroxyls"], limit maybe 5.
